question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word,

I __shirked__ duty in pursuit of a good sleep, incurring my mom's wrath this morning.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"shirked"** means to avoid or neglect a duty or responsibility. (टालना)

 
 
• **Example: **He always **shirked** his responsibilities at work, which caused problems for his team.
 
 
 
• **"Ease" **refers to the absence of difficulty or effort; a state of comfort and freedom from pain or hardship. (सुविधा)
 
 
• **Example: **She completed the task with great **ease**, impressing everyone with her efficiency.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'shirked'** is **'ease'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hate **(नफरत): To feel intense or passionate dislike for someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a deep-seated hate for dishonesty.
 
 
 
• **Indolence **(आलस्य ): Avoidance of activity or exertion; laziness.
 
 
• **Example: **His indolence is the reason why he never finishes any project on time.
 
 
 
• **Fury** (क्रोध): Wild or violent anger.
 
 
• **Example:** The fury of the storm was terrifying to witness.
